commands:
set -eu
D="$HOME/.cache/photomap-rsync-relay-20261101-v1"
if test ! -d "$D"; then echo STAGING_ABSENT; exit 0; fi
date -u '+FIRST_TIME=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
A=$(du -sk "$D" | awk '{print $1}')
F=$(find "$D/storage" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
echo FIRST_KIB=$A FIRST_FILES=$F
sleep 22
date -u '+SECOND_TIME=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
B=$(du -sk "$D" | awk '{print $1}')
G=$(find "$D/storage" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
echo SECOND_KIB=$B SECOND_FILES=$G
echo GROWTH_KIB=$((B-A)) GROWTH_FILES=$((G-F))
ps -axo pid,etime,comm | grep -E 'rsync|ssh' | head -n 12 || true
